headline: Self-employment is high at 13.8 %, while full-time work trails the benchmarks at 65.5 %.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed versus not employed; right: the detailed situation. Band widths show each group's share of respondents. The hatched 'Hidden' flow marks groups with fewer than 3 people, whose values are not shown.
key_findings: Employment totals 89.7 %, of which 65.5 % full-time, 10.3 % part-time and 13.8 % self-employed.
Not employed totals 10.3 %; no one is not seeking work, studying or retired, and seeking work is hidden.
Other situation is hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Self-employment is 6.6 pp above the European region (7.2 %) and 5.8 pp above all schools (8.0 %). Full-time work is 8.7 pp below the region (74.2 %) and 9.4 pp below all schools (74.9 %). Overall employment is 3.5 pp below the region (93.2 %).
caveats: With n = 29, percentages move by several points per person, and two cells are hidden.
